episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki was living a peaceful life along with his friends and family on Sentan Island. This peace was disrupted when sudden war broke out and a strange force took control of his body.
episodes.title: Xam'd at the Dawn of War

episodes.synopsis: Transformed into Xam'd, Akiyuki confronts the enemy invasion in order to protect his friend Haru. Afterwards he is retrieved by the mysterious Nakiami and taken to the postal airship Zanbani, where she lives.
episodes.title: Blackout on Sentan Island

episodes.synopsis: Nakiami performs a special treatment to contain the power of Xam'd in Akiyuki's right arm. At the same time his family and friends look for his whereabouts.
episodes.title: The Way to Freedom

episodes.synopsis: While becoming accustomed to his new environment, Akiyuki begins the distinctive training in order to control his powers.
episodes.title: Enlightenment

episodes.synopsis: Nakiami meets some old acquaintances of hers, and the rest of the crew wonders if she will leave the ship to join them. Meanwhile, a classmate of Haru and Furuichi who lost her entire family surrenders herself to despair.
episodes.title: Shattered Bonds

episodes.synopsis: Haru finally got news from Akiyuki, but just after she and Furuichi joined the military, they are assigned to engage a rogue Xam'd who broke out from a research lab.
episodes.title: Live Fire

episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki receives Haru's letters and after learning that she will be waiting for him at Tsumebara Pass, he leaves with Roppa to meet her. However, he encounters more people turning into humanforms along the way.
episodes.title: Guardians of Stone

episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki and Haru meet again in at Tsumebara Pass, but their reunion is cut short by an angry Furuichi who confronts him after discovering that he became a Xam'd.
episodes.title: Showdown at Tsumebara Pass

episodes.synopsis: Raigyo, a Xam'd like Akiyuki, returns to the Zanbani after two years of absence. All members of the crew seem to be happy to meet him again, but Akiyuki somehow does not share the same feeling.
episodes.title: The Astonishing Raigyo

episodes.synopsis: Raigyo asks for the crew to take a picture together while Haru decides to follow with her military career.
episodes.title: Moving On

episodes.synopsis: The crew of the Zanbani must fend off an assault by Humanforms from the Northern forces.
episodes.title: Assault: The Zanbani

episodes.synopsis: After the incident at the Zanbani, Nakiami decides to return to her homeland and Akiyuki asks to go with her. Meanwhile, Haru pays a visit to Furuichi and finds that he too, became a Xam'd.
episodes.title: Flowers Blooming in the Dark

episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki notifies Haru about his return to Sentan Island but in doing so alerts the military to his presence as well. After a brief visit with his father, Akiyuki meets Haru only to have their reunion crashed by a Furuichi who is eager to use his new found power.
episodes.title: Running Barefoot

episodes.synopsis: Furuichi loses control of his powers and goes berserk, but after being defeated by Akiyuki, he returns to normal. The army intervenes and arrest Haru and Furuichi, while Akiyuki gives cover for Nakiami to escape by holding Commander Kakisu hostage.
episodes.title: Cerulean Skies

episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki loses his sense of self, and with his Xam'd mask permanently affixed, he is captured by a slave trader. Meanwhile, Nakiami continues her journey and meets Yango, a young boy who also became a Xam'd.
episodes.title: Souls at Peace

episodes.synopsis: Nakiami and Yango continue their journey while the southern army starts to perform experiments on Haru's younger sister, and a mysterious creature persuades a kind old woman to buy Akiyuki from the slave traders.
episodes.title: Burning in Our Wake

episodes.synopsis: Haru is given a chance to escape confinement while Nakiami finally arrives at her home village, just to be welcomed by the new chief, her younger sister Kujireka.
episodes.title: Lambs to the Altar

episodes.synopsis: After fleeing from the military, Haru embarks on a journey to find Akiyuki by herself. Meanwhile, Nakiami learns about Kujireka's dubious plan to wage war against the northern government.
episodes.title: What Can you See From There?

episodes.synopsis: Kujireka asks for Nakiami's support, but is utterly rejected and Haru finally manages to reach Akiyuki and help him to recover his memory.
episodes.title: Sudden Outbreak: Romance Flowers Bloom

episodes.synopsis: Nakiami and Yango leave the Tessik village only to see it attacked by a fleet of airships. Akiyuki and Haru meanwhile search for the entrance to the Quickening Chamber
episodes.title: Watered With Tears

episodes.synopsis: Ryuuzou and Haru's father set off to rescue Midori from the East Autonomy Military Facility. Akiyuki and Haru venture further into the Quickening Chamber.
episodes.title: Sanctuary Breached

episodes.synopsis: Raigyo and Ishuu continue their assault on the tower. Ryuuzou confronts Commander Kakisu. Akiyuki and Haru learn the truth about the Quickening.
episodes.title: Tojiro and Ryuzo

episodes.synopsis: Raigyo and Ishuu make their final push into the chamber of the Hiruken Emperor. Nakiami and Yango leave the Tessik airship to stop the battle over the Quickening Chamber.
episodes.title: Hiruken Emperor Born

episodes.synopsis: The Hiruken Emperor is free. Haru, Nakiami and Akiyuki encounter Midori transformed and join forces to stop her.
episodes.title: Voices From Beyond

episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki confronts the Hiruken Emperor by himself while Nakiami completes her training with Lady Sannova.
episodes.title: Nakiami and Sannova

episodes.synopsis: Nakiami seals herself in the Quickening Chamber and the confrontation with the Hiruken Emperor draws to a close. However, Akiyuki turns himself into stone, and nine years later, he awakens and reunite with his loved ones.
episodes.title: The Great Rock and the Girl
